mapper.select: SELECT Q.QNA_NO AS qnaNo, Q.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, Q.QNA_TITLE AS qnaTitle, Q.Q_CONTENTS AS qContents, Q.IS_SECRET AS isSecret, Q.ANS_STATUS AS ansStatus FROM QNA Q LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON Q.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO WHERE Q.ANS_STATUS = 'N' ORDER BY Q.QNA_NO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE QNA SET A_CONTENTS = #{aContents}, ANS_STATUS = 'Y' WHERE QNA_NO = #{qnaNo}
mapper.select: SELECT S.STORE_NO, SU.S_USER_ID, SU.U_STATUS, S.STORE_NAME, S.S_CATEGORY, S.S_ADDR, S.S_FULL_ADDR, S.S_STATUS, SF.FILE_PATH, SF.FILE_NAME, SF.ORIGIN_NAME FROM STORE S LEFT JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID LEFT JOIN STORE_FILE SF ON S.STORE_NO = SF.STORE_NO AND SF.IS_PROOF = 'Y' WHERE SU.U_STATUS = 'PND' AND S.S_STATUS = 'PND';
mapper.update: UPDATE STORE S JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID SET S.S_STATUS = 'GEN', SU.U_STATUS = 'APR' WHERE S.STORE_NO = #{storeNo} AND SU.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STORE_DETAIL ( STORE_NO, SUB_TITLE, S_CONTENTS ) VALUES ( #{storeNo}, '소개 소제목을 입력해주세요.', '소개글을 작성해주세요.' )
INSERT INTO STORE_POLICY ( STORE_NO, REFUND_POLICY ) VALUES ( #{storeNo}, NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE STORE S JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID SET S.S_STATUS = 'REJ', S.REJ_REASON = #{rejReason}, SU.U_STATUS = 'REJ' WHERE S.STORE_NO = #{storeNo} AND SU.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT RR.REPORT_NO AS reportNo, RR.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, R.USER_ID AS userId, RR.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId, RR.REP_STATUS AS repStatus, R.R_CONTENTS AS rContents, ( SELECT RF.FILE_PATH FROM REVIEW_FILE RF WHERE RF.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO LIMIT 1 ) AS filePath, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, R.ORD_NO AS ordNo FROM REVIEW_REPORT RR INNER JOIN REVIEW R ON RR.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO WHERE R.STORE_NO IS NULL AND R.RSV_NO IS NULL AND RR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI' ORDER BY RR.REPORT_NO DESC;

SELECT RR.REPORT_REASON AS reportReason, RR.REPORT_NO AS reportNo, RR.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, R.USER_ID AS userId, RR.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId, RR.REP_STATUS AS repStatus, R.R_CONTENTS AS rContents, ( SELECT RF.FILE_PATH FROM REVIEW_FILE RF WHERE RF.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO LIMIT 1 ) AS filePath, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, R.RSV_NO AS rsvNo FROM REVIEW_REPORT RR INNER JOIN REVIEW R ON RR.REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO LEFT JOIN STORE S ON R.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO WHERE R.PRODUCT_NO IS NULL AND R.ORD_NO IS NULL AND RR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI' ORDER BY RR.REPORT_NO DESC;

SELECT BR.REPORT_NO AS reportNo, BR.BOARD_NO AS targetNo, BR.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId, B.USER_ID AS reportedUserId, BR.REPORT_REASON AS reportReason, BR.REP_STATUS AS repStatus, ( SELECT BF.FILE_PATH FROM BOARD_FILE BF WHERE BF.BOARD_NO = BR.BOARD_NO ORDER BY BF.FILE_NO ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS filePath FROM BOARD_REPORT BR INNER JOIN BOARD B ON BR.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE BR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI' ORDER BY BR.REPORT_NO DESC

SELECT BR.REPORT_NO AS reportNo, BR.COMMENT_NO AS targetNo, BR.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId, BR.REPORT_REASON AS reportReason, BR.REP_STATUS AS repStatus, C.USER_ID AS reportedUserId, C.C_CONTENT AS contents, B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.TITLE AS title FROM BOARD_REPORT BR LEFT JOIN COMMENT C ON C.COMMENT_NO = BR.COMMENT_NO LEFT JOIN BOARD B ON C.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE BR.REP_STATUS = 'WAI' AND BR.COMMENT_NO IS NOT NULL ORDER BY BR.REPORT_NO DESC
